agent.problem: The opening words, "They shine," retell Philippians 2:15, while "as they hold forth the word of life" comes from Philippians 2:16. Citing only Philippians 2:16 is too narrow; this card should cite Philippians 2:15-16.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
